title: Fixed bug with friendly URLs and Media Servers
issue_title: Fixed bug with friendly URLs and Media Servers
issue_body:
### Describe the bug When "Friendly URLs" are enabled together with Media Servers, there's a race condition where it will result in 404 for images either on the Media Server URL or the actual shop URL.
The issue is caused by wrong rewrite rules and the lack of a rewrite rule matching the shop domain. The bug isn't directly apparent on Apache 2.4.x servers because Apache silently "fixes" the rules (`RewriteCond` ending with `[OR]` without a following RewriteCond). The fix is to include the shop domain. ### Steps to reproduce Setup a shop, with "Friendly URL" enabled under "SEO & URLs", then go to Advanced Parameters -> Performance and add a Media Server such as cdn., ideally you' want this to actually be a CDN where the origin URL is configured to shop URL.
Expected result is that the image rewrite works on both the CDN/Media Server URL and shop URL at same time and the image is served as it should.

title: Collect all hooks for the debugger
issue_title: Collect all hooks for the debugger
issue_body:
### Describe the bug
Hooks dispatched using `HookDispatcher` service are not collected by the debugger because the class `LegacyHookSubscriber` doesn't call them. Now they are dispatched, you can see the difference on Administration, Maintenance or Performance page when looking at "not called hooks" in Hooks section of the debugger toolbar.

### Steps to reproduce
Re-install your shop if you didn't do it since the addition of these [hooks](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/pull/8368). Now they are dispatched, you should see one more Hook dispatched in "not called hooks" section of Hooks section of the debugger toolbar for Administration, Maintenance or Performance pages.

title: Allow autoloading in modules for services use in BO
issue_title: Allow autoloading in modules for services use in BO
issue_body:
### Describe the bug
If you declare services in modules and if your module is using Composer as autoloader, the service container breaks during compilation because PrestaShop is unaware of classes inside the module (the module may not be instantiated when the service container is built).

### Steps to reproduce
Declare a service in one of your modules and try to access a "modern" Back Office page.

title: Fixed bug when using 2 swap in 1 form
issue_title: Fixed bug when using 2 swap in 1 form
issue_body:
### Describe the bug
when we using 2 or more swap type in 1 form/page, first swap worked but another is not worked because jquery selector written by id and id must be unique. this PR fix this bug and now we can use many swap in 1 page. meanwhile this problem is also on 1.6

### Steps to reproduce
Create new form and add many SWAP type in your form.
